findings.title: 7个孤儿因外部杀死supervisor（TerminateProcess）导致finally块未执行
evidence: supervisor.log = 0 bytes for all 7 (supervisor started log but wrote nothing)
data/events.ndjson: only exec_spawned, no timeout/exec_failed for these 7
stderr shows worker was alive (502 retries) at time of last heartbeat
Session-level termination confirmed: event stream ended ~60min ago
deadline_at already passed for all 7 (50-62min overdue)
findings.mechanism: Windows TerminateProcess does not run Python finally blocks -> Store.update(state=timed_out) never called -> roster stuck at running
findings.inherited_from_baseline: Structural risk inherited; actual instances are from this dialog session

findings.title: 1个孤儿（test-taxonomy）因锁竞争超时（10s）导致终态未写入
evidence: data/events.ndjson: exec_failed with why=supervisor_error phase=post_spawn
error=LifecycleError: lifecycle lock remained busy for 10.000s
Roster state still running (lock was held by concurrent writers)
LOCK_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_S was 10s in the version that ran this packet
Current lifecycle_supervisor.py shows LOCK_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_S=60.0 (fixed after failure)
findings.mechanism: Lock contention between concurrent supervisor heartbeats/completions; finally block ran but store.update failed; events file used separate lock so exec_failed event WAS recorded
findings.inherited_from_baseline: Partially - Lock timeout fix (10s->60s) introduced in this dialog
